Body.Content: Microsoft Azure StorSimple is now available in Australia with the same service-level agreement coverage that is available in other regions worldwide. StorSimple offers a unique hybrid cloud-storage solution that provides large on-premises capacity for SSD and HDD, and data protection. StorSimple also provides data mobility through access to enterprise data in Azure through the StorSimple Virtual Appliance. This solution optimizes total storage costs and data protection for enterprises, with consolidated management through the Azure portal. To learn more about getting started, see the StorSimple website. For more information about the regional availability for services, please visit our Azure Regions page.
